24	/*! FTS query parameters passed to FtsColumnIndexer::search(). */
25	struct FtsQueryParams {
26	  uint32_t topk{10};
27	  // Optional filter: returns true if a doc should be EXCLUDED.
28	  // Wraps zvec::IndexFilter for push-down filtering inside the search loop.
29	  IndexFilter::Ptr filter{nullptr};
30	  // Candidate-driven (brute-force) mode: ascending segment-local doc_ids;
31	  // when non-empty, FtsColumnIndexer restricts evaluation to this set by
32	  // AND-ing it with the root iterator. Filled by the planner via
33	  // DocFilter::get_bf_by_keys_and_update when an invert result is highly
34	  // selective.
35	  std::vector<uint64_t> candidate_ids;
36	};
37	
38	/*! Per-segment statistics needed by the FTS reducer for doc_id remapping.
39	 *  - min_doc_id / max_doc_id: GLOBAL doc_id range used by the delete filter
40	 *    (filter.is_filtered() takes a global doc_id).
41	 *  - doc_count: number of FTS LOCAL doc_ids in the source segment; the posting
42	 *    list domain is [0, doc_count).  For fresh (non-merged) segments this
43	 *    equals max_doc_id - min_doc_id + 1, and the local-to-global mapping is
44	 *    `global = min_doc_id + local`.
45	 */
46	struct FtsSegmentStats {
47	  uint64_t min_doc_id{0};
48	  uint64_t max_doc_id{0};
49	  uint64_t doc_count{0};
50	};
51	
52	struct FtsIndexParams {
53	  // Supported tokenizers: standard, jieba, whitespace.
54	  std::string tokenizer_name{"standard"};
55	  // Supported filters: lowercase, ascii_folding.
56	  std::vector<std::string> filters{"lowercase"};
57	  std::string extra_params;
58	};
59	
60	}  // namespace zvec::fts
